newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris freighter flights up 20.5 pct Jan-Feb 97.
newsitem.headline: Paris freighter flights up 20.5 pct Jan-Feb 97.

text.p: Full freighters flights at the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle(CDG) and Orly in January-February 1997, totalled 3,475, an increase of 20.5 percent on the same period the previous year, Paris airport authority (ADP) figures show.

Freighter flights operating at CDG totalled 3,175 an increase of 24.4 percent on January-February 1996. However freighter flights from Orly fell by 9.1 percent to 300, reflecting the gradual switch of such services to CDG, an ADP source said.

Total air cargo throughput in the two months amounted to 169,996 tonnes with the full freighter share at 39.1 percent of the overall figure, virtually unchanged on last year's 39 percent for the same period.
In tonnage terms, full freighters moved 66,396 tonnes in January-February this year, a rise of 2.7 percent over 1996.
Full-freighter flights accounted for 3.6 percent of all flights operating at the Paris airports in January- February compared to 3.1 percent in the same 1996 period.
